components.name: Room Plate
components.description: Enamel house-number room plate encoding invoice status via glaze and drawn corner mark.
components.html: 03
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 10px; font: 800 18px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-decoration: none; color: #FFFFFF; background: #0F7A47; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #0F7A47, inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.88); } .ds-plate-mark { position: absolute; top: 9%; right: 9%; width: 26%; height: 26%; } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E9A100; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #16212E; }

components.name: Sign Plate
components.description: Location enamel sign plate header with double inner white rim.
components.html:
Evy Kost Management

Kost Ancol
components.css: .ds-sign-plate { background: #17409C; color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 20px 20px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px #17409C, inset 0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.85); } .ds-sign-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); } .ds-sign-title { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Enamel blue primary action button with 48px touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #17409C; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #10307A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E9A100; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #16212E; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White secondary action button with 2px enamel inset border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #17409C; font: 700 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #17409C; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F4F6F3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E9A100; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #16212E; }

components.name: Upload Target
components.description: Label wrapping a visually hidden file input styled as a primary upload action.
components.css: .ds-upload { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 12px; background: #17409C; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upload:hover { background: #10307A; } .ds-upload:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #E9A100; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #16212E; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 48px white form input with 2px outline border and explicit label.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #16212E; } .ds-field-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; margin-top: 6px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid #7C8794; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #16212E; font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #586472; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E9A100; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #16212E; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Desktop enamel rail item showing active inverted white state and hover state.
components.html: BerandaTagihan
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; background: #17409C; border-radius: 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); text-decoration: none; font-size: 16px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #10307A; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #17409C; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E9A100; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px #16212E; }

narrative.overview: Every room is an enamel house-number plate; the plate's glaze is the room's invoice state. Enamel blue carries the shell and the primary action; colour otherwise lives only on plates. Text stays ink. Built with Tailwind CSS and system fonts.
keyCharacteristics: Enamel blue (#17409C) shell and primary action on a porcelain (#F4F6F3) ground
Square room number plates with inner rim, tabular numerals, and drawn 2px corner marks
System font stack only with weight carrying rank
One surface shadow only, zero decorative metric cards or icon fonts

rules.name: Colour Lives on Plates
rules.body: Body text never takes a glaze colour, except late (#C8281E) for a late status line.

rules.name: Never Colour Alone
rules.body: Every glaze has a drawn corner mark and every plate has an aria-label with the state in words.

rules.name: No Ornament
rules.body: No metric-card rows, no eyebrow labels above headings, no gradient text, no glass, no emoji as icons.

dos: Do format amounts as Rp 1.850.000 (dot thousands, no decimals) with tabular-nums.
Do use system font stack only and drawn 2px stroke inline SVG icons.
donts: Don't add eyebrow labels above headings, gradient text, glass, or metric-card rows.
Don't use colour alone without a corner mark and text state label.
